name: art-institute-chicago-mcp-server
description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection: artworks, artists, exhibitions, provenance, and audio tours via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection: artworks, artists, exhibitions, provenance, and audio tours.
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to the Art Institute of Chicago public API. Search the collection by keyword, artist, department, style, or date range; filter to public-domain works with IIIF image URLs; and fetch full artwork records with provenance, exhibition history, and credit lines. Also covers artist biographies, past and current exhibitions, and audio tour stops with transcripts. STDIO or Streamable HTTP, no API key required.
